model_and_training.privacy: No raw private GPT text, secrets, system prompts or unverified assistant claims in public Git or remote MCP logs
model_and_training.resource_policy: Foreground-first: bounded CPU affinity, below-normal priority, free RAM/VRAM and thermal gates, timed stop, resumable checkpoint
